HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Religious? (1 mark)
   A. Say Religious has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious.
   C. Apply the teaching of Religious with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Religious to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

4. Which response best shows understanding of Basic Prayers? (1 mark)
   A. Say Basic Prayers has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Basic Prayers.
   C. Apply the teaching of Basic Prayers with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Basic Prayers to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

6. Which response best shows understanding of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji? (1 mark)
   A. Use Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji.
   C. Say Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Qualities Of Enlightened Beings? (1 mark)
   A. Say Qualities Of Enlightened Beings has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Qualities Of Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Qualities Of Enlightened Beings.
   D. Use Qualities Of Enlightened Beings to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette:.
   C. Say General Etiquette: has no place in daily life.
   D. Use General Etiquette: to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   B. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Myself [? (1 mark)
   A. Use Myself [ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Myself [ has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Myself [ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself [.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Pranayam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
